decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that remains visible on the website, it is tightly tied to the firm’s stated direction and past commitment, which makes withdrawal unlikely.

Although its website prominence appears lower than at launch, it is still a multi-variant extension close to the core charcuterie business, so management is likely to continue rather than admit a misstep quickly.
This 2024 organic launch sits squarely in the announced growth area and is too recent for management to abandon after already investing in launch and presentation.
A newly launched organic multi-variant line strongly matches the firm’s expansion plan, so sunk launch costs and strategic fit favor retention.
This recent organic salami variant is close to the established assortment and publicly introduced on its own page, which supports giving it more time rather than dropping it soon.
